audit.why: Kit: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8s — but any grounded dagger renews her blink angle, so the E cooldown alone is not the window. Death Lotus 75/60/45s, an interruptible channel Talon has no hard CC to cancel; it also applies anti-heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kit flags misfire twice here: Katarina's Bouncing Blade is flagged 'grounding' and both Rake and Preparation are flagged 'knockup' — none of that appears in Riot's descriptions.
audit.why: Riot text: Q is a bouncing dagger, W is a self-dagger toss with move speed, Rake is a slow. Trusting descriptions over flags per calibration guidance.
audit.corrected: Not written to the page; flags reported here instead.
